title: API Test Workbench — Result Row
description: A single recorded test result. Produced by the send() path, the probe runner, manual entry, or import. This is the primary shape for exports (JSON/CSV/Markdown) and the results table.

id.description: Assigned by the result store on insert. Not present in exported rows until merged.

role.description: Role used for this request. Empty when no role was applied.

status.description: HTTP status, or one of the sentinel strings: ERR (network error), — (manual entry), matrix (imported authz matrix row).

category.description: Free-form. Common values: Functional, Contract, Negative, AuthZ, AuthN, Injection, Headers, Protocol, RateLimit, Manual, AuthZ Matrix.

duration.description: Round-trip time in milliseconds. 0 for manual entries.

probe.description: Legacy free-form label (e.g. 'smoke', 'matrix:user'). Prefer probeId for structured probes.

probeId.description: Structured probe identifier, e.g. 'inj.sqli'. Present when the row came from a probe run.

findings.description: Graded findings produced by probe detection. Empty or absent for plain requests.
